FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say the French letter G? (1 mark)
   A. jay
   B. gay
   C. gee
   D. zhay

2. How do you say 'The cat is under the chair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le sac est dans la chambre.
   B. Où est le chat ?
   C. Le chat est sous la chaise.
   D. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

3. What does 'le livre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the table
   B. the book
   C. the living room
   D. the cat

4. What does 'le chat' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the chair
   B. the table
   C. the cat
   D. the fridge

5. How do you say 'On Saturday, I play.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le jeudi, je chante.
   B. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   C. Une semaine, sept jours.
   D. Le samedi, je joue.

6. How do you say 'When is your birthday?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Bon anniversaire !
   B. J'ai neuf ans.
   C. Merci beaucoup !
   D. Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?

7. Which month is 'janvier'? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. January
   C. June
   D. July

8. Which month is 'décembre'? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. October
   C. February
   D. April

9. What does 'la santé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the mango
   B. vegetables
   C. milk
   D. health

10. What does 'l'oreille' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the neck
   B. the ear
   C. the stomach
   D. the back

11. How do you say 'Tomorrow the weather is nice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait beau.
   B. Demain, il fait beau.
   C. Il neige.
   D. Il fait chaud.

12. What does 'le jardin' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the rug
   B. the garden
   C. the key
   D. the shop

13. In the word salut, which letter is silent? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. t
   C. s
   D. l

14. What does 'C'est ma mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Who is it?
   B. It is the baby.
   C. My brother is called Kamau.
   D. This is my mother.

15. What does 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. Who is it?
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. My mother is called Grace.

16. Which letter has a cedilla? (1 mark)
   A. è
   B. ê
   C. é
   D. ç

17. Which little word goes with 'sac' (the bag)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

18. Fill in: Aujourd'hui, c'est mercredi. Demain, c'est ______. (1 mark)
   A. dimanche
   B. lundi
   C. jeudi
   D. mardi

19. What does 'J'aime le lait.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is good for your health.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. I like milk.
   D. They are mangoes.

20. What does 'C'est un gâteau.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a cake.
   B. I like milk.
   C. I do not like fish.
   D. At midday, I eat rice and beans.

21. What does 'J'ai un nez.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has long hair.
   B. I have a mouth.
   C. I have a nose.
   D. I have ten fingers.

22. Which word needs a capital letter in a French sentence? (1 mark)
   A. salut in the middle of a sentence
   B. merci in the middle of a sentence
   C. Amina
   D. bonjour in the middle of a sentence

23. How do you say 'the window' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la fenêtre
   B. la chaise
   C. la maison
   D. la télé

24. Which day ends in che? (1 mark)
   A. lundi
   B. dimanche
   C. jeudi
   D. samedi

25. How do you say 'I rest' in French? (1 mark)
   A. hier
   B. je me repose
   C. demain
   D. je danse

26. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'February'? (1 mark)
   A. février
   B. fèvrier
   C. fevrier
   D. févrer

27. How do you say 'a month' in French? (1 mark)
   A. une fête
   B. une chanson
   C. un gâteau
   D. un mois

28. How do you write the number 15 in French? (1 mark)
   A. treize
   B. quinze
   C. huit
   D. vingt

29. How do you say 'the mango' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le lait
   B. l'eau
   C. la mangue
   D. le maïs

30. How do you say 'black' in French? (1 mark)
   A. court
   B. noir
   C. long
   D. grand

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: 'Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'Où est le chat ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into French: 'A week, seven days.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: 'Le tapis est devant le canapé.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux mains.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

36. Translate into French: 'It is not good for your health.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'She has black hair.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Voici un cadeau pour toi.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into English: 'Il est grand.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Il pleut.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

41. Write three sentences in French about what you eat in a day. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'This is my mother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je me repose.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Je chante et je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into French: 'On Sunday, I go to church.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: 'Il y a du soleil.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux pieds.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'It is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — zhay
   In French, G is named zhay.

2. C — Le chat est sous la chaise.
   The cat is under the chair. in French is Le chat est sous la chaise.

3. B — the book
   le livre means the book.

4. C — the cat
   le chat means the cat.

5. D — Le samedi, je joue.
   On Saturday, I play. in French is Le samedi, je joue.

6. D — Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?
   When is your birthday? in French is Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?

7. B — January
   janvier means January.

8. A — December
   décembre means December.

9. D — health
   la santé means health.

10. B — the ear
   l'oreille means the ear.

11. B — Demain, il fait beau.
   Tomorrow the weather is nice. in French is Demain, il fait beau.

12. B — the garden
   le jardin means the garden.

13. B — t
   The final t is silent in salut.

14. D — This is my mother.
   C'est ma mère. means This is my mother.

15. D — My mother is called Grace.
   Ma mère s'appelle Grace. means My mother is called Grace.

16. D — ç
   The cedilla is the tail under c.

17. B — le
   sac is masculine, so we say le sac.

18. C — jeudi
   The day after Wednesday is Thursday.

19. C — I like milk.
   J'aime le lait. means I like milk.

20. A — It is a cake.
   C'est un gâteau. means It is a cake.

21. C — I have a nose.
   J'ai un nez. means I have a nose.

22. C — Amina
   Names always begin with a capital letter.

23. A — la fenêtre
   the window in French is la fenêtre.

24. B — dimanche
   Dimanche is the only day that ends in che.

25. B — je me repose
   I rest in French is je me repose.

26. A — février
   The correct spelling is février, with its accents.

27. D — un mois
   a month in French is un mois.

28. B — quinze
   15 in French is quinze.

29. C — la mangue
   the mango in French is la mangue.

30. B — noir
   black in French is noir.
